raw_text: Digital forensics researchers have identified a coordinated social media campaign targeting Indian elections, with network analysis suggesting links to Pakistani intelligence services. The campaign leverages communal fault lines to amplify polarising narratives across Telegram, X, and Reddit. Researchers at the Atlantic Council's DFRLab traced at least 200 inauthentic accounts to IP ranges associated with ISI-linked infrastructure in Rawalpindi.
clean_text: Digital forensics researchers identified a coordinated social media campaign targeting Indian elections linked to Pakistani intelligence services. At least 200 inauthentic accounts traced to ISI-linked infrastructure.
